split: fixed seed-42 10% physical-group carve from WED TRAIN
sam_candidate: dense_grid_box; 25 seed prompts, no output cap

pixel.macro_food_iou_definition: mean over food classes present in DEV; excludes classes with zero DEV ground-truth pixels
pixel.per_class_iou_interval_definition: 95% percentile bootstrap over the mean of per-view IoU within each resampled physical meal group

semantic_regions_class_aware.definition: derived 8-connected components per semantic class, one-to-one IoU>=0.5 matching

regions_class_agnostic_comparison.definition: same 8-connected per-class semantic regions used as ground truth; predictions compared class-agnostically by one-to-one IoU>=0.5 matching

metrics.sam2_note: SAM2 proposals have no class IDs. Pixel per-class metrics and exact class-set accuracy are not defined for SAM2; region matching is class-agnostic for both methods on the same views.
